description: We’re Team Relax Zone from Sofia. We’re interested in Earth observation, radar imagery, and making scientific data easier to explore. We built SARtainty, an interactive app that lets people compare NASA–ISRO NISAR radar images over time and see what changed on Earth’s surface.
summary: Project Relax Zone is an interactive app designed to make NASA–ISRO NISAR radar imagery easier to explore. By comparing observations of the same area on different dates, users can see where Earth’s surface appears to have changed. Our goal is to make satellite radar useful to students, educators, and curious explorers without requiring specialist GIS software.
details: Project Relax Zone makes it easier to answer a simple question: what changed here between two satellite passes?
